name: Incident Response
author: Aetherion
description: Triage → contain → mitigate → postmortem, with an on-call digest at the end.

steps.title: Triage
steps.detail: Classify severity P0–P3 from blast radius. P0/P1 page the on-call.

steps.title: Contain
steps.detail: Stop the bleeding: disable the bad deploy, rate-limit, or flip the feature flag. Do not fix yet.

steps.title: Mitigate
steps.detail: Apply the minimal safe fix; every destructive command goes through the security gateway.

steps.title: Postmortem
steps.detail: Timeline, root cause, what worked, what didn't, actions with owners. Blameless.

definitionOfDone: incident resolved, postmortem published, on-call digest posted after human review.
